neet_phy_u13_t00_2.working: The radial leads point at O, so they give no field there. For the arc, B = (μ0·I/4πR)·θ with θ = 3π/2, giving B = 3μ0·I/(8R).

neet_phy_u13_t00_3.working: On the axis, B = B0·R³/(R²+x²)^(3/2). With x = √3R this is B0·R³/(2R)³ = B0/8 = 40/8 = 5 μT.

neet_phy_u13_t00_4.working: The two arcs are in parallel, so I1·R1 = I2·R2. Resistance is proportional to θ, so I1·θ1 = I2·θ2. The arc fields are equal and opposite, making the net field zero. So A is false and R is true.

neet_phy_u13_t00_5.working: Rewinding into two turns halves the radius and doubles N. Since B ∝ N/R, B becomes 4 times larger, so I is correct. For a point on the element's own line, dl × r = 0, so dB = 0; II is correct.
